entities.name: Aisha Abubakar Abdulwahab
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dr. Aisha Abubakar Abdulwahab was a Nigeria policewoman who won a UNESCO fellowship award to study tuberculosis. She was in charge of palliative support program at the force Headquarters, Abuja during the coronavirus pandemic.
